step1_analysis.description: A CMOS peak detector used for Automatic Gain Control (AGC) in a burst-mode receiver. It uses a differential amplifier and a source follower in a feedback loop to track and hold the maximum input voltage, with a PMOS switch to reset the hold node high.

paper_reference.title: A Burst-Mode Receiver for 1.25-Gb/s Ethernet PON With AGC and Internally Created Reset Signal

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency tracking gain of the closed-loop buffer

sky130_expected.calculation: Loop gain T = gm1 * (ro2 || ro4) ~= 36. Closed loop gain = T/(1+T) ~= 0.97 -> -0.26 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite output resistance of the differential pair limits the open-loop gain, resulting in a closed-loop gain slightly less than 1 (0 dB).

bw_3db.description: Tracking bandwidth of the peak detector

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at N3 is ~150 MHz. With loop gain of 36, closed-loop bandwidth extends to ~1 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported operating frequency for the 1.25 Gb/s EPON standard.

track_error.description: Voltage difference between the input peak and the held output peak

sky130_expected.reasoning: The finite loop gain causes a small steady-state error during tracking.

v_reset.description: Output voltage when the reset signal is asserted (active low)

sky130_expected.calculation: When RESET_BAR=0, N1=1.8V. OUT = 1.8V - Vgs5. Vgs5 at 14uA is ~0.52V. OUT = 1.28V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS switch pulls the gate of the source follower to VDD, forcing the output to VDD - Vth.

power.description: DC power consumption of the sub-circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the tail current source added to bias the differential pair.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure tracking bandwidth, peak detection accuracy, and reset behavior.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Peak Detector Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm5_prime=5u L_xm5_prime=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N0 IN N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 VDD N1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM5_PRIME VDD N1 OUT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5_prime} w={W_xm5_prime}
XM3 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 N1 RESET_BAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Missing connections and biasing
Vshort N1 N2 DC 0
I_tail N5 GND 200u
C_hold N3 GND 250f
C_out OUT GND 250f
R_discharge N3 GND 100k
R_discharge_out OUT GND 100k

VVDD VDD GND 1.8
VRESET RESET_BAR GND PWL(0 1.8 10n 1.8 10.1n 0 15n 0)

* Input source: DC + AC + Transient Pulse
VIN IN GND DC 1.0 AC 1 PWL(0 1.0 1n 1.0 1.1n 1.1 1.5n 1.1 1.6n 1.0 3n 1.0 3.1n 1.1 3.5n 1.1 3.6n 1.0)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis for tracking bandwidth
  ac dec 20 1Meg 10Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(out)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis for peak detection and reset
  tran 10p 15n
  meas tran v_peak_in max v(in) from=0 to=5n
  meas tran v_peak_out max v(out) from=0 to=5n
  let track_error = v_peak_in - v_peak_out
  print track_error
  
  meas tran v_hold find v(out) at=9n
  meas tran v_reset find v(out) at=14n
  meas tran t_reset trig v(reset_bar) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(out) val=1.2 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
